knowledge_gaps: The latest item has cosine similarity 1 with itself. With logits = -age + cosine and five items, its pooling weight is at least approximately 0.636 for nonzero embeddings. The branch may therefore reinforce an isolated latest purchase rather than identify coherent repeated interests.

The four proposed ablations separate architecture from loss but do not isolate the added agreement weighting. Include decay-only pooling and a latest-item-only residual before attributing gains to agreement.

The negative-sampling implementation is incomplete: batches provide no user IDs, yet exclusions require each user's training history. Specify how histories are associated with examples, the small-eligible-set fallback, and whether baseline exclusions remain unchanged.

Reproduction details remain unspecified: optimizer settings, temperature, projection initialization, normalization settings, padding behavior, gradient flow through agreement weights, checkpoint selection, and allocation of the remaining GPU budget.

Zero gating preserves initial scores only when shared baseline weights are identical. Additional initialization can consume random numbers and change subsequent initialization or sampling despite using seed 42.

The originality, potential, and difficulty scores are subjective. Originality 5 needs comparison with established similarity-weighted pooling and gated sequential recommenders; practical difficulty must include efficient per-position negative sampling and predictor parity.
No procedure is specified for the required twenty-user full-catalog simulator recommendations. Their qualitative feedback must remain separate from the pinned validation selection metric.
